Hospitalization rates within 90 days after vaccination were also similar for each treatment group in each study (study 1: LAIV, 1.2%; TIV, 1.4%; study 2: LAIV, 3.4%; TIV, 3.3%). A review of all hospitalization diagnoses demonstrated that, in study 1, there were ten hospitalizations due to LRI (e.g., pneumonia, croup, wheezing, bronchospasm; LAIV, n=6; TIV, n=4), five of which occurred within 90 days after vaccination (LAIV, n=2; TIV, n=3). In study

2, there were 18 hospitalizations due to LRI (LAIV, n= 11; TIV, n=7), 15 of which occurred within 90 days after vaccination (LAIV, n=8; TIV, n=7).

Relative efficacy
